metadata.description: Ninety-item self-report inventory covering a broad range of psychological and somatic symptoms.
metadata.intended_use: Psychotherapy, rehabilitation, psychosomatic care, and research profiling of symptom burden.
metadata.development_history: Developed as a broad symptom inventory with multiple symptom dimensions and global indices.
metadata.measurement_rationale: A broad profile can identify areas requiring clinical exploration rather than reducing distress to one symptom score.
metadata.interpretation_notes: Profile scores are not diagnoses and can be affected by response style and setting; use the German norms and manual.
